hr.equipment.v1.ApproveEquipmentBody.description: ApproveEquipmentBody carries approval decision fields bound from the HTTP payload.

approved.description: True to approve, false to reject.

equipment_request_id.description: ID of the equipment request being reviewed.

success.description: Whether the approval action was processed.

hr.equipment.v1.AssetPayload.description: AssetPayload is a physical asset assigned to an employee.

assigned_date.description: Date the asset was assigned to the employee (ISO-8601 date).

condition.description: Physical condition of the asset (new | good | fair | damaged).

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was created.

employee_id.description: Employee the asset is currently assigned to.

name.description: Human-readable name of the asset (e.g. "MacBook Pro 16-inch").

owner_id.description: Tenant owner this asset belongs to.

returned_date.description: Date the asset was returned; absent if still assigned (ISO-8601 date).

serial_number.description: Manufacturer serial number; absent if not tracked.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was last updated.

description.description: Free-text description of the specific equipment needed.

needed_by_date.description: Date by which the equipment is needed (ISO-8601 date); absent if no deadline.

hr.equipment.v1.EquipmentRequestPayload.description: EquipmentRequestPayload is a request for equipment made on behalf of an employee.

approved_by.description: Employee who approved the request; absent if not yet approved.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was created.

current_approval_level.description: Current step in a multi-level approval chain.

delivered_at.description: Unix timestamp when the equipment was delivered; absent if not yet delivered.

description.description: Free-text description of the specific equipment needed.

id.description: Unique identifier for the equipment request.

needed_by_date.description: Date by which the equipment is needed (ISO-8601 date); absent if no deadline.

owner_id.description: Tenant owner this request belongs to.

status.description: Workflow status (pending | approved | ordered | delivered | rejected).

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was last updated.

condition.description: Filter by condition; absent to include all conditions.

employee_id.description: Filter by employee; absent to include all employees.

assets.description: Page of assets matching the filters.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

total.description: Total number of matching assets across all pages.

requests.description: Page of equipment requests matching the filters.
